name: go2-sim
description: Simulated Unitree Go2 in MuJoCo: a walking robot with ROS 2 topics and a browser 3D viewer, for testing without the real robot. Runs on x86 or ARM Linux devices.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port for the simulator's web viewer — open http://<device>:<port> in a browser. Change it if another simulator already uses 8890.
